name: correctness-classify
description: Calibration harness orchestration: routes an EXPECTED/OUTPUT pair through judge-correctness and emits the CHOSEN verdict as its output (each branch is a code node returning its own name). That makes the judge eval-able — an eval with an `exact` scorer measures the judge's verdict accuracy against labeled pairs. Pair with datasets/correctness-calibration.json + evals/correctness-calibration.json.
